title: DroughtObsDeclarationRelationship
description: Cross-domain link between a DroughtObservation and a DroughtDeclaration. Geometry overlap or temporal proximity is evidence of relationship only — not identity, authority equivalence, or causal derivation. This record may not assert that a declaration was derived from an observation or vice versa.

x-kfm.anti_collapse_rule: Geometry overlap is evidence of relationship only — not identity or authority equivalence. A newer physical observation does not rescind a legal declaration. A later declaration does not rewrite historical observations.

_fixture_meta.description: Optional fixture-only metadata. Not present in production records.

relationship_id.description: Stable identifier for this relationship record.

observation_ref.description: Reference to the DroughtObservation (observation_id). Must use obs: prefix.

declaration_ref.description: Reference to the DroughtDeclaration (declaration_id). Must use decl: prefix.

relationship_kind.description: Nature of the relationship. 'cited_as_evidence' does not imply derivation or authority transfer.

derivation_claimed.description: Must always be false. Derivation of legal stage from observation category is forbidden by the anti-collapse invariant.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about the relationship.
